budget.time_limit_argument: The L40S-based limits stay. RTX PRO 6000 ran the K16 BF1 finals 1.7-2.4x faster than L40S; H100 NVL ran MF M0 at L40S speed. The longest completed unit (M1 K32 on L40S) used 6623 s of its 10800 s limit.
budget.never_extended: unchanged: no limit, ceiling, step count or seed is increased after any result is seen

reporting.pairing_caveat: The K16 references and the 12 completed units ran on NVIDIA L40S. A seed-1003 K8/K32 unit that runs on RTX PRO 6000 or H100 NVL is compared with its L40S K16 reference, so its difference includes the hardware difference. K effects for seed 1003 are reported with their hardware, by hardware stratum and pooled. No claim of cross-hardware equivalence.
reporting.pooled: the pre-registered statistics and bootstrap unchanged (default_rng(20261019), same order), every unit labelled with GPU and node
reporting.strata: the same statistics within each GPU type of the K8/K32 unit (default_rng(20261020)); the L40S stratum is the hardware-matched sensitivity; a one-seed stratum is descriptive only, without a grid label
reporting.interpretation: the pre-registered grid labels the pooled view; when the pooled label and the L40S-stratum label differ, both are reported and the result is called hardware-sensitive
reporting.costs: native allocated GPU-h per unit with GPU type and node, plus totals per type
reporting.implementation: scripts/v10_capacity/capacity_table_hw.py (frozen with this amendment); capacity_table.py remains the base view, in which the seed-1003 units (amendment root) appear as INCOMPLETE
